timing: Before confirmatory freeze and before any final holdout observation
repair: PASS only with a real admitted bounded/decoupled gain, unchanged gates, valid evidence separation, exact recovery/reproduction and acceptable regression checks
ability_PASS: All preregistered stream, discrimination, ablation and retention gates, and pooled RMSE better than original-S2, continued legacy and independent full-refit controls
ability_PARTIAL: Pooled RMSE improves all three matched controls but at least one preregistered ability gate fails
ability_FAIL: Pooled RMSE does not improve at least one of original-S2, continued legacy or independent full-refit; or unacceptable retention regression
ability_BLOCKED: Valid source, engineering prerequisite or independent final evaluation unavailable
history: Report independent history magnitude benefit as negative if masking and conditional permutation do not both worsen pooled holdout error; do not substitute previous-action contribution
no_changes: No sample size, threshold, seed, mechanism or checkpoint selection changes after final holdout
